status: NYC DOT regular-shelter dimensions are sourced; weather, occupancy and local delivery profiles are illustrative assumptions, not field or manufacturer measurements

geometry.source_title: New York City DOT Street Design Manual: Bus Stop Shelter, regular size
geometry.zoning: Three equal strips along length; x=0 is the assumed device end. Positions do not constitute a measured delivery profile.
geometry.area_basis: Gross plan footprint; bench and structure have not been subtracted. Not net standing area or rated capacity.
geometry.height_role: Configuration descriptor; not a closed, uniformly cooled air volume.

occupancy_note: Illustrative mean simultaneous counts, not NYC measurements or capacity estimates. The 12-person and concentrated 8-person-zone cases are crowd-concentration stress scenarios. Gross densities are diagnostics, not assertions about available standing space.
